questions.text: Which electricity meter do you have? — It decides which plans you can switch to.
Urban or rural? — It’s on your bill. Rural standing charges are about €70 a year higher.
Who do you pay now? — Not sure? We’ll estimate.
Any discount on top of the 16%? — Your plan’s 16% is already in its prices. Only add a discount your bill shows beyond it.
Is your gas with Electric Ireland too? — It changes what a switch is worth.
Where in Ireland is the home? — The sunshine, and how cold it gets, differ by region.
Which way does the roof face? — The side that gets the sun.
How steep is the roof? — Most Irish roofs are 30–40°.
How many panels? — For your usage we suggest 7.
A battery? — It stores the day’s solar for the evening.
Did the panels go up around 12 May 2025? — Your meter file shows power sent to the grid from then. A battery can hold winter’s spare solar, so the panels may have been up before.
What did the panels cost? — Roughly is fine. Including VAT, before any grant.
Did you get the SEAI grant for them? — Up to €1,800 for the panels.
